decisions.summary: One reach constant for every canopy tree (PERSIMMON_SHADE_FT -> tree_shade.CANOPY_SHADE_FT, the sun page's west-lane reach); the persimmon's seat keeps its own form
decisions.why: FR-002 verbatim: one reach, the working windbreak tree's, one predicate. Unchanged since round 1.

decisions.summary: _sun_keepouts on the keep-outs mixin, on for a map keeping the sun corridor, covering drawn plots and every placed bundle's yard and gardens
decisions.why: FR-001 binds a scripted map; the legacy hand-drawn exemption is the spec's own Edge Case. Unchanged since round 1, where the opt-in was measured as set by the one scripted settlement generator.

decisions.summary: Every tree site takes the keep-out: the _crown_covers sites, the woodland commons' throws and woodland_room grid, the scrub hill pines (recorded as scrub_pines), the perimeter dike's willow row (dike_willows, thinned once plots stand); the persimmon already keeps it
decisions.why: Round 1's items are all carried: the commons' throws and room grid are held, R1's false premise is rewritten, the inventory's method is stated, the scrub pines are held and recorded. But the stated method - the union of the five pool manifests' ink_classes - samples what five maps happened to draw, not what the scripted generator can draw, and it misses a canopy placer: the FRUIT DIKE. hamletgen/plan.py:479 rolls dike_crop from DIKE_CROPS = (mulberry x3, fruit x2, tea) (hamletgen/consts.py:408) on any mulberry_dike_fishpond hamlet that does not pin it (pool/hamlets/kuwabata/kuwabata.gen.py:37 says so: 'the knob also rolls fruit'); hamletgen/water/polder.py:242-248 passes it to apply_land_use, and settlement/fields/landuse.py:511-516 draws, for crop 'fruit', 'standard trees at ~18 ft' (lychee, longan, citrus; r 4-5 px) on the band's centerline, inked straight into the SVG and recorded in neither tree_crowns nor any list D6 reads. FR-001 names 'a fruit tree' and 'any later kind' and binds every scripted map, so R1's 'Nothing else on a hamlet draws a tree' is false and the fruit dike is passed silently - the same oversight as round 1's commons, with no argument offered. Fix: add the fruit dike's trees to D3 (drawn in the field/polder stage before the plots, so held like the dike willows: recorded and dropped once the plots stand, or drawn after them) and record them so D6 counts them; restate R1's method as the generator's vocabulary (the interactive class registry, l7r/diagram/interactive/classes/*.py: it carries fruit dike, tea dike, burial ground, field rock and homestead bamboo, which the five manifests do not) read class by class; and correct the plan's Summary, which still says 'Every drawn canopy crown already passes one test before it is inked - _crown_covers' and 'handed to every crown test' - the premise R1 now disowns.

decisions.summary: The perimeter dike's inner mulberry row and the mulberry dikes' rows are coppiced mulberry, not canopy, and do not take the keep-out (MODE 1 exception check)
decisions.why: Adjudicated against 'no canopy trees should be exempt' and on each case. The exclusion is implied by the GM's own word: the GM first said 'ANY trees' and then narrowed it to 'canopy trees', with bamboo as the example of a plant that 'doesn't create much shade'. The record says cultivated mulberry was 'for the most part trained as low bushes ... pruned once a year to 1.5 to 1.8 m (~5-6 ft)' (research/questions/0026-mulberry-and-other-crops-on-pond-dikes-sangji-guoji.html), and the engine draws it as such (landuse.py:492-499 and dikes.py:263, coppiced bushes r 2.2-3.6 px, half the willow's): a crop stool cut back every year forms no canopy, so excluding it reads the GM's qualifier rather than completing the GM's thought. Purpose test: the rule exists so a plot keeps its sun; at the record's own ratio (a ~33 ft tree throws ~50 ft) a 5-6 ft bush throws under 10 ft, so the exclusion does not gut it. Class check: both rows are the same thing (dikes.py:263 'coppiced, same form as the pond banks'); the plan did NOT stretch the argument over the perimeter dike's POLLARDED willows, which it holds. Conditions: the exclusion covers coppiced mulberry only (the fruit dike's standard trees are canopy - see D3); it is recorded in the spec's Decisions table and on the sun page with its class and why; and, as an exception that passed this check, it is raised with the GM once the implementation works.

decisions.summary: The perimeter dike's willow row, drawn before any plot exists, is thinned of each willow in a plot's sun once the homesteads stand
decisions.why: FR-004's operative clause is 'no stage after may draw one there'; a placer that runs before the plots exist cannot test against them, and dropping each offending willow once they do leaves the same map the clause asks for. The willows are held to the full rule, not excepted.

decisions.summary: The copse's west-lane exemption and its unsupported comment are removed; the lane stays as a seat prefilter
The farm grove's seat-time strips stay as seating preferences; every text presenting a strip as the sun rule is rewritten
decisions.why: Round 1's ruling stands and its condition is now carried in the plan: the _yard_sun_conflict docstring, _garden_sun_conflict's 'by construction', rolling/dispersed.py's and hamletgen/consts.py's comments are listed for rewriting as seating preferences, and no record page or modal may describe a strip as how a grove keeps a plot's sun. The strips exempt nothing once D3 holds every crown at draw time, and re-seating to the full reach would move houses, which the spec's Assumption sets aside.

decisions.summary: One map check, trees_shading_plots, over tree_crowns, scrub_pines and dike_willows; persimmons_shading_plots retired into it; gate test over the five hamlets and the cohort audit
decisions.why: FR-005 asks for a check that 'counts every canopy crown in a plot's sun'. The lists it reads omit the fruit dike's trees (landuse.py:511-516 records none), so on a fruit-dike hamlet the check is blind to a whole class of canopy tree. Same root cause as D3, adjudicated separately because the check is the backstop: fix with D3 by recording the fruit dike's trees and reading that record here. Enforcement of the request otherwise - not unrequested scope.

decisions.summary: The sun page states the one rule and the bamboo exemption as the GM's choice; the persimmon bullet folds in; modals checked by entry-drift
